reviewedObligations.name: Input and identity boundary
reviewedObligations.assessment: Duplicate JSON keys, depth/node/byte capacity, Unicode scalar and UTF16 identity bounds, unsupported fields and outcomes fail closed. Per-key version identities are distinct from global transaction identities.

reviewedObligations.name: Source and version-order provenance
reviewedObligations.assessment: Incomplete supplied orders or unknown sources remain gaps. Intermediate external sources are direct EXT obligations. No order is completed from transaction array, event time or an existential witness.

reviewedObligations.name: Finite completeness for the declared question
reviewedObligations.assessment: Every total CO extending complete factual final orders is considered. For fixed CO, prefix cuts are enumerated. Each cut depends only on fixed CO/final writes and the target transaction; no cross-target cut product is necessary. Successful choices construct INT/EXT/PREFIX/NoConflict. This is a bounded code review, not a machine-checked proof or full isolation classifier.

reviewedObligations.name: Observation order and INT
reviewedObligations.assessment: Original program order determines prior own operations. A valid own intermediate read is not retroactively invalidated by a later overwrite. Unsupported savepoint and abort semantics are declined rather than flattened.

reviewedObligations.name: Budget completeness
reviewedObligations.assessment: Charged visits check their bounds before execution; an unfinished branch cannot prove unsatisfiable. Bookkeeping excluded by contract is bounded. The empty real-transaction execution is a separate direct proof, clarified additively without changing code or counts.

reviewedObligations.name: Positive certificate verification
reviewedObligations.assessment: The literal witness checker independently checks CO, prefix visibility, sources, operation-order obligations and shared-writer visibility; it does not invoke search or trust a graph cycle absence.

findings.issue: The original general per-CO counter sentence did not explicitly state that the empty execution is a direct proof before enumeration. Existing preregistered zero-budget case and implementation already agreed.

limitations: Only committed complete unique-version point registers within six transactions, 128 operations/keys; no raw SQL, scoped journals, predicate/list/relation semantics or real-time/session facts.
No database authentication, complete six-model classification, Elle equivalence, stable release, human acceptance or official acceptance is asserted.
52 boundaries had hand expectations and an author summary only; their full per-case certificates were not retained or audited.
The separate fixed-result comparison independently replayed 1014 generated positive certificates; this static review did not rerun any previous case.
